variants.name: Cover=Unavailable
variants.reason: A stale catalog passes unavailableReason; native disabled button, grayscale cover and a visible accessible reason prevent opening until a successful rescan.
variants.exercise: Change workspace to an unavailable root, verify disabled cards and no modal, then rescan the retained root and open a real session.

evidence.test: S1 poster variants retain gradients and unavailable cards recover after rescan

propertyMapping.reason: Same gradient treatment for all three; catalog has no category contract.
ProjectLibrary supplies an explanation when the catalog is stale; it does not claim every individual directory has disappeared.
Real catalog metadata; Figma sample text is not application data.

components.designVersion: S0 snapshot-only; three component-set screenshots re-read on 2026-10-26; no official Code Connect publication

variants.name: State=Active
variants.reason: An existing DockSurface header is the mapped unit. Current panels remain visible together: Active means :focus-within, Inactive means focus outside. This is an explicit composition difference from Figma stacked tabs; no selected/onClose prop is invented.
variants.exercise: Focus the context header, then the conversation input; verify both highlight states. Drag the context panel and collapse it through its real menu, retaining the session and draft.

evidence.test: S1 session and dock compositions preserve selection, focus and close semantics

propertyMapping.reason: Labels are actual panel identities supplied by the existing panelNames registry.
Focus state in a simultaneous-panel layout, not tab selection hiding sibling content.
Close is the existing menu action 收起面板; drag and keyboard menu moves use DOCK_PANEL. Neither stops a Run. The last visible panel cannot be hidden.

components.designVersion: S0 snapshot-only; three component-set screenshots re-read on 2026-10-26; no official Code Connect publication

variants.name: State=Active
variants.reason: Map one session item inside SessionTabStrip; state.activeTabId determines aria-selected. Preserve current responsive width, project subtitle and inactive close button (pointer accessible, tabindex -1), rather than claiming pixel parity with Figma.
variants.exercise: Create two real sessions, verify selected/unselected colors and close focus policy, activate and close each, reopen retained sessions. Close and reopen a running session without stopping its Run.

evidence.test: S1 session and dock compositions preserve selection, focus and close semantics
stops mid-run and shows 已停止 only after background convergence

propertyMapping.reason: Library and Settings labels are fixed; project subtitle derives from session.project.name.
SessionTabStrip renders a list from state.openSessionIds; a single instance is not the entire strip.
Rendered only for session tabs; closing does not delete the session or stop its run.

constraints: Design is visual evidence, not behavioral authority.
Preserve retained S1 differences; no inferred Grant, stop or Unknown state.
No automatic merge, issue edits, Figma writeback or real Provider execution.
